comparison.objective: Close and latch an inside-fitting pressure cooker.
comparison.physical_skill: Tilt an oversized oval lid through a smaller mouth, reorient, seat and engage a locking loop.
comparison.success_condition: Lid fully seated and latched with hands off; tipping or falling invalidates success.
comparison.reason: A constrained rigid-part insertion and latching task, with no free-particle flow or selective retention.
